claim_boundary: fixed-weight descriptive channel/relationship predictor screen; no mechanism, intervention, routing, adaptation, or learning claim
final_slot_match: both primary arms end with base cue-pair4 at reliability .5
fitting_boundary: Fit projections, centering/scales, decoders, trackers, PCA/subspaces, and coupling/modulation models only on base-order train32. Apply unchanged to paired eval32; condition labels/outcomes never enter a fit.
outcome: per-seed median across projections of delay8 base-minus-upstream true R2; latest/shuffle verify controls only
baseline_only: full 6x6 Jacobian-block Frobenius atlas at cue6 and delay8
finite-time source-channel sensitivity to every target at horizons1,2,8
integrity: route accounting exactly reconstructs target preactivation/update
preregistered analytic Jacobian blocks agree with central finite differences
heldout-state and label adversarial fit-isolation tests
save states, route tensors, fits, predictions, hashes
screen_gate: Nominate at most one metric only if its base-minus-upstream contrast and rank association with the seed-level outcome have the same direction in at least 5/6 seeds; resolve eligible ties by standardized base-train-scaled effect magnitude. No nomination means stop. Jacobian/sensitivity atlas is never eligible for selection.
confirmation: Run only a winning named metric and exact controls on six fresh seeds. Confirm the same contrast and association direction before any perturbation/rescue protocol.
